name: Cyril Morlet
title: Systems Engineer — Rust · Distributed Systems · ex-Bitfinex
summary: Systems engineer (12 years) with exchange DNA: at Bitfinex I owned deposit/withdrawal chain integrations where a bug loses customer funds. Rust in production: a chain indexer (axum, tokio, checkpoint streaming into Redis 8) serving sub-second reads, plus a maintained gas-sponsorship fork. Honest Rust depth: intermediate-plus with one production system, not a decade. Around it: deep distributed systems — real-time messaging and eventing for live game backends, WebSocket fanout across 1,300+ users' sessions, storage on Redis and FalkorDB — production Kubernetes operated solo, observability with Prometheus and Sentry, incident response as my own on-call. Web3-native since 2018. Based in Da Nang, Vietnam.
